individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a domain map schematic combined with western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/blot, not a plot, so error bars are not applicable.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel B shows bar charts of densitometry quantification (% depletion and log2 abundance) from a single blot measurement per antibody, not averages across replicates, so individual data points are not required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Bars represent single densitometry measurements without error bars, so no definition is required.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel C is a heatmap of averaged (two biological replicates) normalized abundances across proteins/antibodies; heatmaps are not expected to show individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: A heatmap does not use error bars, so none are required.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel D is a violin plot showing the full distribution of enrichment ratios across many co-isolated proteins; violin plots inherently display the data distribution so individual overlay points are not required.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Violin plot of log2 enrichment ratio (HTT IP vs mIgG IP) distribution for proteins co-isolated with HTT Q20 or Q140 from the striatum (8 weeks)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: The violin plots include dashed lines for median/quartiles but the caption does not explain what these dashed/dotted lines represent (e.g., median, quartiles).

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E shows bar plots with individual data points overlaid (n = 4 dots per condition) in addition to the mean bar.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption explicitly states error bars represent mean ± SD with n = 4.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel F is a sequence alignment with a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel F is a sequence/structure panel, not a plot, so error bars are not applicable.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel G is a scatterplot where each point represents an individual co-isolated protein's enrichment ratio, i.e., individual data points are inherently shown.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel G is a scatterplot of individual protein values without error bars, so none are required.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel H is a scatterplot where each point represents an individual IP-MS experiment, i.e., individual data points are inherently shown.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel H is a scatterplot/correlation plot of individual experiments with a fit line but no error bars, so none are required.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each point represents an individual sample, i.e., individual data points are inherently shown.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel I is a PCA scatterplot of individual samples without error bars, so none are required.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel J is a set of PCA scatterplots where each point represents an individual sample, i.e., individual data points are inherently shown.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel J is a PCA scatterplot of individual samples without error bars, so none are required.
